newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends firmer at 2,780-2,860 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends firmer at 2,780-2,860 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 2,780-2,860 per dollar, up from the midday's 2,900-2,920 and 3,000 at the opening due to higher dollar supply and amid a lev shortage in banks, dealers said.
"Banks and clients were selling dollars to boost lev liquidity but there were not many buyers and the lev closed some 200 firmer on the day," one dealer said.

The lev rise however was likely to last only until banks received large interest and maturity payments on government securities or final clients started bidding for large dollar volumes, traders said.

"Lev liquidity in the banking system was so low today that if someone has offered $10 million the lev could have probably regained to 2,000," another dealer said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
